not_known: I only keep this for people the owner introduced me to. Nothing was kept.
unavailable: I could not reach what is kept right now. Nothing changed; try again shortly.
remember_how: Say what to keep, like this: remember this: what you want me to remember.
too_many: I already keep {max} things of yours. Delete one first with: forget and its number.
too_long: That is too long to keep. The limit is {max} characters.
nothing_kept: I have nothing of yours kept here.
list_header: What you asked me to keep:
list_footer: To delete one, say: forget and its number.
forget_how: Say what to forget, like this: forget this: part of the text, or forget and the number on the list.
forget_none: I did not find that among what I kept here. Nothing was deleted.
forget_many: {count} kept things match that. Ask for the list and use the number.
